changes.title: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 in Azure Functions ends on September 1, 2027
changes.detail: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 on Azure Functions is ending on September 1, 2027. Your apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Java 8,
